path.description: Absolute path of the worktree root added to the pool; the root, when a directory inside it was given.

project.description: Identifier of the project whose pool has the worktree.

main.description: Whether this is the main worktree of the project.

action.description: What happened: added or unchanged. The list is open: a client shows an unknown value as is.

agents.description: What the layout of subagents in the worktree added did; present only when there is something to tell.
